verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੩੦ : ਛੇਵੇਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਸਿੱਖ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 30 : chheve(n) guroo jee dhe hor si'kh

en.bdb: Other Sikhs of the sixth Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਗੁਆਲੀਏਰ ਸੁਇਨੀ ਹਰਿਦਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: lasakar bhaiee teerathaa guaale'eer suinee haridhaasu|

en.bdb: Bhai Tiratha is from Laskar and Hari Das Soni belongs to Gwalior.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵਾ ਧੀਰੁ ਉਜੈਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: bhaavaa dheer ujain vich saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh nivaasu|

en.bdb: Bhava Dhir comes from Ujjain and resides in Word and the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲ ਵਡਾ ਬੁਰਹਾਨਪੁਰਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਖ ਸਹਜ ਪਰਗਾਸ।
verses.translit_en: mel vaddaa burahaanapur sanamukh sikh sahaj paragaas|

en.bdb: Famous are the Sikhs of Burhan Pur who love one another and reside in the equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਭਈਆ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਲਿ ਬੋਦਲਾ ਘਰੇ ਉਦਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat bhieeaa bhagavaan dhaas naal bodhalaa ghare udhaasu|

en.bdb: Bhagat Bhaia Bhagvan Das is the devotee and with him is a Sikh named Bodala who lives in his home becoming fully detached.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਲਕੁ ਕਟਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰਥੀਮਲ ਜਰਾਦੀ ਖਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: malak kaTaaroo jaaneeaai piratheemal jaraadhee khaasu|

en.bdb: Kataru, the noble one and physician Piathimal are especially well known personalities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੂ ਛੁਰਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਡਲੂ ਰੀਹਾਣੈ ਸਾਬਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: bhagatoo chhuraa vakhaaneeaai ddaloo reehaanai saabaasu|

en.bdb: Devotee Chhura and Dallu are said to be the inhabitants of Haryana.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦਾਸ ਦੁਇ ਵੰਸ ਵਧਾਵਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: su(n)dhar suaamee dhaas dhui va(n)s vadhaavan kaval vigaasu|

en.bdb: Sundar and Swami Das both are developers of the tradition of Sikhism and live always like a blossomed lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਜਰਾਤੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਭਾਬੜਾ ਸੁਲਾਸੁ।
verses.translit_en: gujaraate vich jaaneeaai bhekhaaree bhaabaRaa sulaasu|

en.bdb: Bhikhari, Bhavara and Sulas are Gujarati Sikhs.
All these Sikhs consider loving devotion as their way of life.
